title: Samples Origami: quickpatch standup notes - 2026-11-10
content:
Meeting: Samples Origami - quickpatch standup
Date: 2026-11-10
Time: 11:00 - 11:25 PT (25m)
Facilitator: Sofia Martinez
Attendees: Sofia, Marcus, Priya, Daniel, Kai (joined late)

Purpose: rapid triage for a small set of regressions discovered in the new quickstart templates and two flaky sample tests that blocked the onramp pilot. Goal was to align on immediate mitigations and a small follow-up set for next week.

TL;DR
- Root cause for cache-dup tokenization failures narrowed to the streaming wrapper in node/ts quickstart; patch in flight (PR #789).
- Two flaky tests in samples repo (embed-smoke, chat-stream-e2e) are likely infra/timeouts; added additional retries + smaller payloads as temporary mitigation.
- Decision: ship quickpatch to staging by EOD Thursday, hold back broad onramp release until Monday unless staging is clean.

Notes / Discussion
1) Quickstart streaming regressions (Marcus)
- Repro: Node quickstart streaming stalls after ~12 tokens when prefix cache enabled and client-sent chunk sizes vary. Happens on Node 18 & 20 on our CI images.
- Hypothesis: our stream framing wrapper double-applies backpressure when a non-empty KV cache header is present, causing some message bytes to drop into an unfinished chunk.
- Action: Marcus opened PR 789 that adds explicit drain/flush points in the streaming helper and a unit test that simulates variable chunk boundaries. Needs review and a small rewrite to be less invasive to python sample parity.
- Risk: low to medium; touching core streaming helper could impact other SDKs. Marcus to add a quick compatibility test across python/node in CI.

2) Embed-smoke flaky (Priya)
- Error mode: occasional 504s in CI when running bulk-embeds test; locally can't repro. Logs point to intermittent timeouts on the internal test harness hitting Hosted API test endpoint.
- Short-term fix: added 3x retry with exponential backoff and reduced batch size from 512 -> 128 tokens in samples repo PR 412.
- Long-term: instrument the harness with per-request timing and mark slow-network nodes in CI so we can exclude them from smoke runs. Priya to file ENGDx-412 (tracking).

3) Chat-stream-e2e (Daniel)
- Failure: message ordering flips ~1/1k runs on agent-turn tests. Seems correlated with heavy concurrency on runner-03. Noticed a spike in GC and CPU steal on the runner during failures.
- Mitigation: pin the runner to a less busy host for the next upstream run and add an ordering-assert relaxation for flaky test (logged as technical debt). Daniel to take lead.

4) Quickstart docs + sample parity (Kai)
- Concern: the Node quickstart patch changes the SDK stream API subtly (adds an optional flush flag). We must reflect this in quickstart docs and sample comments before merging.
- Plan: small docs blurb + snippet showing the new optional param and recommended default. Kai will prepare the change in docs repo and a one-line CHANGELOG entry.

Decisions
- Merge strategy: land PR 789 behind a feature flag and enable in staging only after green compatibility tests. If staging passes 3 consecutive runs, lift feature flag for onramp samples.
- Release cadence: quickpatch to staging by EOD Thu (11/12). If clean, release to production samples Monday (11/15) with a short post-deploy smoke run.

Action Items (owners + target)
- Marcus: finish PR 789 changes, add python/node compatibility tests, request reviews (target: 2026-11-11 EOD).
- Priya: follow up on ENGDx-412 (instrumentation ticket), merge PR 412 (retries + smaller batches) after 48-hour soak in staging (target: 2026-11-12).
- Daniel: re-run chat-stream-e2e pinned to runner-02, add ordering-relaxation, post results in thread (target: 2026-11-12).
- Kai: update quickstart docs and samples README to mention the flush flag and streaming caveats; draft CHANGELOG blurb (target: 2026-11-11).
- Sofia: coordinate release window with release-engineering and QA; schedule 30m handoff with onramp pilot team for Monday morning (target: 2026-11-12).

Notes to self / open questions
- Is there a way to add a deterministic unit test for chunk-boundary behavior in pure JS without spinning up full server? Marcus thinks yes, will prototype.
- Consider adding a small streaming harness (local runner) that can fuzz chunk sizes — useful beyond this bug. Put on backlog if no time this week.
- Should we add a healthcheck-level flag on samples to disable prefix cache for quickstarts in CI while we validate? Tradeoff: less realistic test coverage vs faster, more stable CI. Put up for discussion in #devexp-samples.

Follow-ups / next meeting
- Quick follow-up async check-in on PR statuses tomorrow morning (Sofia will ping).
- Full sync next Tues 2026-11-16 to review release outcome and remaining flakies.

Raw links / artifacts referenced
- PR (streaming fix): https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/789
- Samples PR (embed retries): https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-samples/pull/412
- Jira: ENGDx-412 (embed infra instrumentation)
- Jira: INF-2345 (streaming test flake tracker)
- Slack channel: #devexp-samples (thread pinned with logs)

Quick checklist (for release)
- [ ] PR 789 reviewed + compatibility tests green
- [ ] Docs updated (flush flag) and CHANGELOG entry written
- [ ] Staging soak 48h with three green runs
- [ ] Release-engineering windows confirmed
- [ ] Onramp pilot alerted and briefed

End notes: keep this doc as the short-lived runbook for the patch. Will convert to a retrospective note in Drive if the roll forward hits major issues. 

- Sofia
